name: Maryland

period.description: Eligibility is figured over a six-month period that starts with the month you apply.

submission.description: Give your case manager at the local Department of Social Services a bill or receipt showing the service, the date, and how much you still owe.

notes: If insurance might pay a bill, it must be sent to the insurer and denied before it can count.
Bills count when you get the care; future costs cannot be estimated ahead of time.
Bills for medicine or equipment must list the item, the date and the cost.

sources.title: Section 900 Determining Financial Eligibility for Non-Institutionalized Persons - Maryland Medical Assistance Manual
